body.name: Saturated legal-fiber certificate and atomic charts
body.construction: Apply \(\mathfrak H_{1,3}\) to the complete modified map used by Tramontano et al.: reproduce its elimination basis and beta quadratic over \(\mathcal D_{1,3}\), then adjoin \(\mathcal R^{\mathrm{legal}}_{1,3}\) and return an exact Stengle Positivstellensatz or equivalent real-quantifier-elimination certificate that the additional beta factor has no legal lift on \(s_{1,3}\ne0\). List the rational three-atom formulas, the nonempty semialgebraic boxes \(\mathcal W_3\) and \(\mathcal W_2\), and define \(\Psi_3,\Psi_2^{+},\Psi_2^{-}\) to return \(\bot\) outside those boxes.
